title: Alignment Orbit: Focus Sprint Blueprint — Staffing & Communications (Q2 2025)
body:
Purpose:
This doc defines a concentrated 6-week "Focus Sprint" ("Alignment Orbit") to finalize Q2 company OKRs, align exec updates, and rehearse the all-hands narrative. Goal is to reduce ambiguity across Product, Eng, SRE, and GTM while locking staffing commitments for mission-critical launches (Hosted API improvements, Dedicated capacity scaling, and Private deployment pilot readiness).

Audience:
Company leadership, product and engineering leads, people ops, communications, and the all-hands owners. Use as the single source of decisions and runbook for the 6-week window.

High-level Sprint Objectives (Draft OKRs):
- O1: Finalize and commit Q2 company OKRs by end of week 2. (Owner: Maya T.)
  - KR1: 90% of teams have written and cross-linked team OKRs to company-level outcomes.
  - KR2: Execs have endorsed rollback/rescope thresholds for top 3 risks.
- O2: Prepare an all-hands narrative and supporting materials that clearly signal priorities and trade-offs. (Owner: Arjun P.)
  - KR1: Draft slides and exec talking points completed and rehearsed with 2 dry runs.
  - KR2: Two-sided FAQ and 5 demo snippets (hosted API, Dedicated, Private, Optimize, Console) ready for release.
- O3: Secure staffing runway and escalation roster for launch-critical work. (Owner: Priya N.)
  - KR1: Staffing commitments (FTE/week) for top initiatives signed off by managers.
  - KR2: Two fallback plans defined for capacity or hiring shortfalls.

Sprint Timeline (6 weeks):
- Week 0 (Prep): collect team drafts, baseline metrics, risk register.
- Week 1: cross-team OKR workshop; gap analysis; identify owners and decision points.
- Week 2: exec alignment sessions; finalize company OKRs; freeze baseline for comms.
- Week 3: comms sprint — slide deck, FAQ, demo coordination; hire/contract escalation check.
- Week 4: rehearsal week — leadership dry runs and feedback loop; finalize Q&A.
- Week 5: buffer & contingency; publish comms; coordinate with CS for customer-facing notes.

Week-by-week Runbook (actions and outputs):
- Week 0 (Owner: Maya): collect team okr drafts to /confluence/INF-4532; metric owners upload baseline numbers; product writes 1-paragraph impact statements for each candidate OKR.
- Week 1 (Owners: product, eng leads): 2 half-day workshops (Mon, Wed) to reconcile overlapping objectives; output: proposed company OKR spreadsheet and decision log.
- Week 2 (Owners: CEO, Head of Eng): 60-minute exec sync to sign-off or escalate; output: signed OKR doc and red/amber/green risk map.
- Week 3 (Owners: comms, Arjun): first full deck draft + short video demos recorded; publish internal rehearsal calendar.
- Week 4 (Owners: execs): two dry runs (internal + cross-org) with timeboxed Q&A practice; collect edits.
- Week 5 (Owners: comms + people ops): finalize announcement, update handbook, schedule follow-up team forums.

Staffing Matrix & Asks (quick list):
- Critical roles to assign now:
  - OKR curator (temporary): Maya T. — consolidates and maintains decision log.
  - Launch engineer liaison: Diego R. — coordinates deployments and SLO expectations.
  - Demo owners: Product PMs (Samantha L. and Arjun P.) — ensure reproducible demos.
  - Comms lead: Arjun P. — slides and script.
  - People ops: Priya N. — resource approvals and contractor plans.
- Immediate asks to managers this week: confirm availability for 6-week window, identify 2 backup ICs per functional lead, flag any hiring offers that may impact sprint capacity.

All-hands Plan (brief):
- Date target: Week 5 Wednesday (finalize after exec sign-off in Week 2).
- Length: 60 minutes. Format: CEO opening (10 min), product demos (15 min), metrics & OKRs (10 min), org asks and hires (10 min), live Q&A (15 min).
- Pre-reads: 1-pager OKR summary + 3 quick demo clips.
- Cue cards for execs: explicit transitions, 90-second talking points per slide, and 2 fallback lines for controversial topics (pricing, hiring).

Exec Update Template (send week 2 and week 4):
- TL;DR: 3 bullets (progress, asks, risk).
- Bullet 1: OKR sign-off status and callouts.
- Bullet 2: Staffing/hiring snapshot (headcount delta, contractor needs).
- Bullet 3: Deployment & reliability readiness (SLOs, fallback policy).
- Attach: risk register and decision log.

Communication Cadence & Channels:
- Weekly syncs: Monday 30-min cross-functional check-in (standup); Wednesday OKR workshop deep dives.
- Slack: #q2-alignment (pinned decisions), #all-hands (announcements + AMA thread).
- Confluence: single source of truth under INF-4532 with clear section for artifacts.
- Email: Exec summary sent to entire company after Week 2 sign-off and again at all-hands publish.

Decision Points & Governance:
- Final decision on company OKRs at Week 2 exec sync. Escalation path: if disagreement, use 48-hour arbitration window with CEO and two VPs.
- Hiring trade-offs: People Ops and CFO must sign-off on any >2 FTE reallocation within 5 business days.

Risks & Mitigations:
- Risk: key engineer unavailability near demo week. Mitigation: designate alternate demo engineer; pre-record demos where possible.
- Risk: last-minute product regressions. Mitigation: staged demo environment and automated smoke test; fallback demo clips showing last stable features.
- Risk: misaligned comms generate confusion. Mitigation: locked slide deck + 48-hour embargo on changes; Q&A bank curated by comms.

Outputs to publish (post-sprint):
- Final company OKR doc (confluence INF-4532).
- All-hands slide deck + recorded video.
- Decision log (confluence link) + risk register with owners.
- Staffing commitments spreadsheet and escalation roster.

Immediate next steps (this week):
1) Managers: upload team OKR drafts to INF-4532 by EOD Friday (Owner: all managers).
2) People Ops: circulate temporary staffing approval template (Owner: Priya N.).
3) Comms: skeleton slide deck and rehearsal schedule (Owner: Arjun P.).
4) Eng leads: nominate launch liaisons and backups (Owner: Diego R.).

Appendix: rehearsal checklist (short)
- Slide deck ready + speaker notes at least 5 days before all-hands.
- 2 dry runs scheduled: one with execs, one cross-org.
- Demo smoke tests passing on staging.
- FAQ live and pinned in #all-hands.

Notes and open questions:
- Do we want a separate customer-facing product letter the week after the all-hands? (Asked of CS and GTM).
- Are there any impending legal compliance announcements that should be isolated from the general comms? (Legal to flag).

Record of changes:
- 2025-03-14: initial draft (Maya T.).
- 2025-03-18: added staffing matrix and rehearsal checklist (Priya N.).
- 2025-03-20: updated timeline and risk mitigations after exec feedback (Arjun P.).

End of doc.
